# What Asterisk 20.6 (Ubuntu 24.04) answered to each AGI command over FastAGI, on a Local channel
# with no caller pressing keys. Recorded by ~/.bvtest/agi/oracle (oracle.py); the usage text is left out.
>> ANSWER
<< 200 result=0
>> CHANNEL STATUS
<< 200 result=6
>> STREAM FILE nothing-here ""
<< 200 result=-1 endpos=0
>> STREAM FILE beep ""
<< 200 result=0 endpos=3520
>> STREAM FILE beep "12"
<< 200 result=0 endpos=3520
>> WAIT FOR DIGIT 100
<< 200 result=0
>> GET DATA beep 100 2
<< 200 result= (timeout)
>> GET OPTION beep "12" 100
<< 200 result=0 endpos=3520
>> SAY DIGITS 12 ""
<< 200 result=0
>> SET VARIABLE COLOUR blue
<< 200 result=1
>> GET VARIABLE COLOUR
<< 200 result=1 (blue)
>> GET VARIABLE NOTHING_SET
<< 200 result=0
>> GET FULL VARIABLE "${COLOUR} sky"
<< 200 result=1 (blue sky)
>> DATABASE PUT bvtest k1 v1
<< 200 result=1
>> DATABASE GET bvtest k1
<< 200 result=1 (v1)
>> DATABASE GET bvtest k2
<< 200 result=0
>> DATABASE DEL bvtest k2
<< 200 result=1
>> DATABASE DELTREE bvtest
<< 200 result=0
>> DATABASE DELTREE bvtest
<< 200 result=1
>> NOT A COMMAND
<< 510 Invalid or unknown command
>> WAIT FOR DIGIT
<< 520-Invalid command syntax.  Proper usage follows:
<< (usage text)
<< 520 End of proper usage.
>> EXEC Set DONE=yes
<< 200 result=0
>> GET VARIABLE DONE
<< 200 result=1 (yes)
>> EXEC NoSuchApplication x
<< 200 result=-2
>> SET EXTENSION 600
<< 200 result=0
>> SET CONTEXT somewhere
<< 200 result=0
>> SET PRIORITY 1
<< 200 result=0
>> SET AUTOHANGUP 0
<< 200 result=0
>> VERBOSE "hello" 1
<< 200 result=1
>> NOOP
<< 200 result=0
>> RECEIVE CHAR 100
<< 200 result=-1 (hangup)
>> TDD MODE off
<< 200 result=0
>> SEND TEXT "hi"
<< 200 result=0
>> SET MUSIC off
<< 200 result=0
>> HANGUP
<< 200 result=1
>> STREAM FILE beep ""
<< HANGUP
<< 511 Command Not Permitted on a dead channel or intercept routine
>> NOOP
<< 200 result=0
